# Test fixtures

- `codex-debug-models-0.162.1.json`: the output of `codex debug models` (the refreshed catalog, not `--bundled`) on Codex CLI 0.162.1, run on 2026-10-11 and reduced with `reduce_codex_models.py` to each model's `slug`, `visibility`, `default_reasoning_level` and effort values, in the catalog's order. It holds no account data: the reduction drops every other key. `test_dictionary.py` and `test_modellist.py` check `providers/codex/dictionary.toml` against it. When the dictionary is brought up to a newer Codex version, or the refreshed catalog of the same version changes, a new reduced copy replaces this one.
- `reduce_codex_models.py`: makes such a copy. `python reduce_codex_models.py full.json codex-debug-models-<version>.json`.
- `model-list-equal.json`, `model-list-missing-mapped.json`, `model-list-new-model.json`: model lists in the shape `codex debug models` prints, written by hand against the fixture Codex dictionary of `support.py` and not against a real catalog. The first holds that dictionary's models; the second lacks `gpt-6-astra`, which the dictionary maps to the frontier tier; the third adds `gpt-7-nova`, offered, and `gpt-internal`, hidden, with keys the reader does not know. The third case of R8.1, a provider with no list, is the fixture Claude Code dictionary, which names no command. `provider_stub.py` prints them in place of a provider's program; the tests of `init` and of the model list use them.
- `codex-prompt-input-0.160.0.json`, `codex-prompt-input-profile-0.160.0.json`: the output of `codex debug prompt-input <prompt>` and of `codex --profile manager debug prompt-input <prompt>` on Codex CLI 0.160.0, run on 2026-10-05 in a scratch home that held what `render` installs from this repository and no credentials, and reduced with `reduce_codex_discovery.py prompt-input`. Kept: each message's `type` and `role`, the skills section whole, and the first lines of every other text; the second file so begins with the Manager's instructions. The scratch home is written `/home/user`. `codex --profile <a name with no file> debug prompt-input` gave, with exit code 0, what the first file holds, so it has no file of its own. `test_discovery.py` reads them: the skills a model may load are listed, the invoke-only ones (`self-reflection`, the loaded roles) are not, and no agent name is anywhere.
- `codex-app-server-skills-list-0.160.0.jsonl`: what `codex app-server --listen stdio://` printed, in the same home on the same day, when sent `initialize`, `initialized` and `skills/list`; reduced with `reduce_codex_discovery.py skills-list` to the answers' ids, each notification's method, and each skill's `name`, `enabled`, `scope`, `path`, `pluginId` and the first words of its `description`. The clone is written `/home/user/clone`. It lists the invoke-only skills too.
- `reduce_codex_discovery.py`: makes such copies. `python reduce_codex_discovery.py prompt-input full.json out.json HOME CLONE`, and the same with `skills-list`.
- No fixture holds output of a session with a model: none was started. `doctor --prove-discovery --save-probe DIR` writes the reduced form of the two session probes (`claude-code-init.json`, `codex-exec-events.json`); a copy of each, from a real run, belongs here.
